commands.assertions: A device surface with buttons and properties renders an explicit screenless control panel with readable capabilities and owner-access state; no fake remote screen is offered.
Screenless device panel and localized strings compile.

assertions: Device panel rendering is selected by SurfaceKind.DEVICE_PANEL.
Button and property capabilities are presented by name and readiness.
The panel explicitly states that no screen is available and does not mount desktop imagery.
limitations: Owner actuation controls are intentionally not fabricated; direct action routing for physical devices remains owner-side work.
